purpose: Learning line for word problems in four steps (years 3-m1): which story structures, how big the numbers and how often an unneeded given or an introduction appears.
details: Structures grow from simple sums to change, discount, speed and rest problems; the step of prices shrinks (1 euro to 1 cent); fractions and percentages are added. Loaded by kern/leerlijnen.py (laad/parameters) which the topic's generator calls with the child's school year; checked by tests/test_leerlijnen.py and turned into the handbook tables by docs/tools/handleiding.py.

field_notes.explanation: The stored skill id this learning line belongs to; the same as the file name. Stored ids are never renamed.
A short Dutch description of the skill (shown in the handbook and reports).
Goals of the skill (a list; empty for most skills).
The parameters of this skill and their type name (lijst, int, bool, tekst, getal); a value of the leerlijn must match.
Per school year (3, 4, 5, 6, m1, m2) the parameter values; a missing or null year means the skill is not offered then (the level cannot be chosen).
The kinds of word problem (structure/variant) that occur.
Upper limit for the numbers in the questions.
Largest factor/count of groups used in the stories.
The step of prices in euros (as text).
The step of weights in grams (0 = no weights).
Denominators used in the 'fraction of a number' stories.
Probability that a story contains a given that is not needed.
Probability that a story starts with an introductory sentence.
